_comments.name: Generation run name in lowercase snake_case; this is a label, not the spoken target.
_comments.target_variants: Wakeword strings to synthesize as positive examples. Change these to select the actual wakeword.
_comments.counts: Smoke test: 2 accepted samples per class/split, 8 total. Rejected samples go to review; each group retains the 3N synthesis attempt limit.
_comments.language_code: Recognition language. The current adversarial text generator supports English (en) only.
_comments.min_vosk_confidence: Minimum Vosk confidence for accepting a recognized target word, from 0 to 1. Separate from the training classification threshold.
_comments.augmentation_rounds: Number of augmentation rounds used to produce feature rows from accepted audio.
_comments.custom_negative_phrases: Additional negative phrases to synthesize; these should not contain the target wakeword.
_comments.prefix: Short text before the target word for positive synthesis.
_comments.suffix: Short text after the target word for positive synthesis. Vosk extracts the target word from this utterance.
_comments.seed: Random seed for generation; independent of the training seed.
_comments.batch_size: Submit up to 2 tasks together to test BrainBox batch submission.
_comments.augmentation_batch_size: Batch size for local audio augmentation and feature extraction.
_comments.resource_folder: Local resource cache path, resolved relative to this configuration file.
_comments.resource_specs: Pinned resource specifications for feature models, phonemization, augmentation audio and ACAV background features. Usually keep unchanged.

_comments.schema_version: Configuration format version. Keep 1 for the current loader.
_comments.model_name: Safe output file name without an extension; the exported model is <model_name>.onnx.
_comments.seed: Random seed for initialization and sampling (integer from 0 through 4294967295). Cross-platform bitwise reproducibility is not guaranteed.
_comments.device: Training device: cpu, auto (CUDA when available, otherwise CPU), or cuda (fails if unavailable). ONNX validation always uses CPU.
_comments.num_threads: Number of CPU threads used by PyTorch and ONNX Runtime.
_comments.mode: Run label: smoke or production. This label does not change the explicit iteration counts.
_comments.stage_steps: Sampling iterations for each of the three training stages. Hard mining and gradient accumulation can produce fewer optimizer updates.
_comments.stage_learning_rates: Base learning rate for each of the three stages. Each stage creates a new Adam optimizer and uses warmup, hold, and cosine decay.
_comments.batch_counts: Examples sampled with replacement per iteration: positive = target-word features; adversarial_negative = generated negative features; background = ACAV windows. All three counts must be positive integers.
_comments.accumulation_examples: Minimum retained examples accumulated before an optimizer update. A nonempty remainder is applied before the final validation of each stage.
_comments.max_negative_weight: Initial maximum negative-example loss weight. Each stage ramps from 1 to this maximum; the maximum can double after stages 1 and 2 if the best historical background rate remains above the target.
_comments.target_window_fp_per_hour: Target threshold-positive background windows per feature-equivalent hour, used for negative-weight adaptation. This is not a rate of independent audio activation events.
_comments.threshold: Classification threshold in [0, 1]: a score greater than or equal to this value is positive. Separate from Vosk recognition confidence.
_comments.validations_per_stage: Maximum validation events per stage, from 1 through 20. Short stages may have fewer unique validation iterations.
_comments.validation_start_fractions: Fraction of each stage elapsed before validation starts. For example, 0.75 uses the last quarter; 0 starts immediately; 1 validates only at the end.
_comments.validation_batch_size: Maximum examples or background windows evaluated together. Lower values reduce batch memory use.
_comments.export_atol: Absolute tolerance for PyTorch-versus-ONNX probability parity: abs(reference - exported) <= export_atol + export_rtol * abs(reference).
_comments.export_rtol: Relative tolerance in the ONNX parity check; used together with export_atol.
_comments.recipe_version: Training recipe identifier. Keep notebook-28-v1 unless implementing a new versioned recipe.
_comments.selection_version: Checkpoint selection policy identifier. Keep percentiles-v1 for the current implementation.
_comments.background_version: Background segmentation and window policy identifier. Keep segmented-windows-v1 for the current implementation.
